what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Sri Lanka, as counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 4806 people displaced by conflict and violence, while UNHCR counted 4099 IDPs of concern.
IDMC and UNHCR count differently, so their figures don't match.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka with the LTTE in 2003 and from 2005 to 2009, at war level in most of those years.
IDMC's disaster records for Sri Lanka list floods, storms, erosion and mass movements.

when.text: IDMC's figures fell from 400000 in 2009 to 4806 in 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 and 2010, at the end of the war.

how.text: In 2019, IDMC recorded 1700 new displacements by conflict and violence: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Sri Lanka.
